children: Triumph declared a $17.81 quarterly cash dividend on its 7.125% Series C preferred stock, payable Sept. 30 to holders of record Sept. 15.
Board declared $17.81 per share quarterly cash dividend on 7.125% Series C preferred stock.
Dividend equals $0.44525 per depositary share (each depositary share = 1/40 of a preferred share).
Dividend payable Sept. 30, 2026 to holders of record as of close of business Sept. 15, 2026.
Announcement disclosed via press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing.
